description: List the supporters who have marked a payment as sent and are waiting for the creator to approve them. Kulhad cannot see a bank account, so this is what people say they sent, not what has been received. The creator checks their own bank app for the amount and the four-character code, then approves.
name: list_pending_supports

code.description: The four-character reference in the payment note. Absent for counter QR payments.

flagged.description: The word filter flagged the message. It is not blocked.

reply.description: The public thank-you the creator wrote.

source.description: Which link or surface it came from.

supporterName.description: Absent when they chose to stay anonymous.

total.description: How many are waiting in all.

totalAmount.description: What all of them add up to, not only the ones returned.

title: List supporters waiting for approval
